title: The Story of the PING Program

date.notes: Participant retrospective; exact original web-publication date should be recovered from BRL/ARL archive metadata.

publisher_or_issuer: Mike Muuss / BRL-ARL web archive lineage

claims_extracted.claim: Mike Muuss identifies himself as the author of the Unix ping program and describes the sonar-inspired name and ICMP Echo Request/Reply timing mechanism.
Muuss says a July 1983 remark by Dave Mills about Fuzzball ICMP Echo latency measurement inspired the idea, and that he coded ping after BRL network trouble in December 1983.
claims_extracted.notes: Participant testimony; corroborating Mills/Fuzzball source remains to be found.

notes: Participant testimony is strong for authorship/inspiration but should not substitute for source-code provenance.
